greek: Καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν ποιήσεις δέκα αὐλαίας ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης καὶ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου· χερουβιμ ἐργασίᾳ ὑφάντου ποιήσεις αὐτάς.
hint: The tent is made of ten curtains of spun linen, blue, purple and scarlet, with cherubim woven in.

hint: The ark goes behind the veil, which divides the holy place from the most holy.

notes.text: ἐσώτερος, interior, the comparative of ἔσω, one translation, plain text; the neuter as an adverb, with a genitive.
Of the holy of the holies, ἅγιος used as a noun, the neuter, twice.

reading: and [[you will set|you will set, you will put, you will place, you will plant, you will lay|τίθημι]] [[the curtain|the curtain and veil|καταπέτασμα]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[the pillars|the pillars, the supports and bearings|στῦλος]] and [[you will carry into|you will carry into, you will bring in and contribute, you will pay the property-tax, you will bring|εἰσφέρω]] [[there|there, in that place|ἐκεῖ]] interior [[of the curtain|of the curtain and veil|καταπέτασμα]] [[the wooden box|the wooden box and chest and coffer|κιβωτός]] [[of the testimony|of the testimony and proof|μαρτύριον]]; and [[will draw a boundary through|will draw a boundary through and divide by limits and separate, will distinguish and determine and define, will determine and declare, will determine one to be, will draw distinction and lay down definitions, will remove across the frontier and banish, will carry abroad|διορίζω]] [[the curtain|the curtain and veil|καταπέτασμα]] to you [[up to middle|up to, up along, and throughout the middle, in the middle, the centre, mid, between two|ἀνά + accusative; μέσος]] [[of the devoted to the gods|of the devoted to the gods and sacred and holy, of the holy and pure|ἅγιος]] and [[up to middle|up to, up along, and throughout the middle, in the middle, the centre, mid, between two|ἀνά + accusative; μέσος]] [[of the devoted to the gods|of the devoted to the gods and sacred and holy, of the holy and pure|ἅγιος]] [[of the devoted to the gods|of the devoted to the gods and sacred and holy, of the holy and pure|ἅγιος]].

greek: καὶ κατακαλύψεις τῷ καταπετάσματι τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ τῶν ἁγίων.
hint: The ark of the testimony is screened by the veil in the most holy place.

notes.text: κατακαλύπτω, to cover up, one translation in the active, plain text; the middle's having veiled oneself left to the middle.
You will cover up with the veil: the Hebrew has wĕnātattā ʾet-hakkappōret, you shall put the mercy seat on the ark.

reading: and you will cover up [[to the curtain|to the curtain and veil|καταπέτασμα]] [[the wooden box|the wooden box and chest and coffer|κιβωτός]] [[of the testimony|of the testimony and proof|μαρτύριον]] [[in the devoted to the gods|within, inside of, and by means of the devoted to the gods and sacred and holy, the holy and pure|ἐν; ἅγιος]] [[of the devoted to the gods|of the devoted to the gods and sacred and holy, of the holy and pure|ἅγιος]].

greek: καὶ θήσεις τὴν τράπεζαν ἔξωθεν τοῦ καταπετάσματος καὶ τὴν λυχνίαν ἀπέναντι τῆς τραπέζης ἐπὶ μέρους τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ πρὸς νότον καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν θήσεις ἐπὶ μέρους τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ πρὸς βορρᾶν.
hint: Table and lampstand stand outside the veil, the lampstand on the south side, the table on the north.

notes.lemma: ἐπὶ μέρους τῆς σκηνῆς τὸ πρὸς νότον
notes.text: The article τό, accusative, over the phrase, the one, with the side meant.

greek: καὶ ποιήσεις ἐπίσπαστρον ἐξ ὑακίνθου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης, ἔργον ποικιλτοῦ.
hint: A screen for the entrance is embroidered of blue, purple, scarlet and linen.

notes.text: ἐπίσπαστρον, not in Middle Liddell: LSJ's rope for pulling, net, and that which is drawn over, curtain, hanging, citing this verse.
ποικιλτής, a broiderer, one translation, plain text.

reading: and [[you will make|you will make, you will do, you will produce, you will create|ποιέω]] [[rope for pulling|rope for pulling, net, the latch or handle by which a door is pulled to, that which is drawn over and curtain and hanging|ἐπίσπαστρον]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of hyacinth|of hyacinth, of sapphire|ὑάκινθος]] and [[of purple-fish|of purple-fish, of purple dye and purple, of purple raiment|πορφύρα]] and of scarlet [[of having been twisted by spinning|of having been twisted by spinning and spun and standing so|κλώθω]] and [[of a fine flax|of a fine flax, of linen made from it|βύσσος]] [[of having been twisted by spinning|of having been twisted by spinning and spun and standing so|κλώθω]], [[work|work, business, deeds, action, works of industry and tilled lands|ἔργον]] of a broiderer.

greek: καὶ ποιήσεις τῷ καταπετάσματι πέντε στύλους καὶ χρυσώσεις αὐτοὺς χρυσίῳ, καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν χρυσαῖ, καὶ χωνεύσεις αὐτοῖς πέντε βάσεις χαλκᾶς.
hint: The screen hangs on five gilded uprights with gold capitals, cast on five bronze bases.

notes.text: χωνεύω, to cast into a mould (χόανος), one translation, plain text; the Greek word is Middle Liddell's own.
χαλκοῦς, filed under χάλκεος, of copper or bronze.
